text:
lucy: Quick check-in on accessibility for the new Insights table & mini charts. Noticed two things: keyboard focus ring is invisible on mac/chrome for focused rows, and VoiceOver reads chart legend items in a weird order. Anyone else running into this?

devin: I can repro the focus ring loss. Looks like we apply `transform` on .table-row wrappers for GPU compositing; Chrome clips the outline because of the stacking context.

omar: Repro details: macOS 13.6 + Chrome 117. Tab to the table -> use ArrowDown to move rows -> press Enter to open actions -> Tab -> focus goes into the flyout but Shift+Tab sometimes lands behind the overlay.

priya: For the focus ring, we switched from outline to `box-shadow` for other components to avoid clipping. Quick CSS I used: `:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(3, 102, 214, 0.9); border-radius: 6px; }` That survives transform/stacking contexts. Need to validate in dark theme and high-contrast mode.

devin: Also found overflow:hidden on .table-viewport causing the ring to clip. Two possible fixes: remove `overflow:hidden` when a descendant has focus-visible, or place the focus indicator on an ancestor that isn't clipped. But moving the indicator up changes spacing.

omar: Chart legend issue: VoiceOver reads legend entries but doesn't say which color maps to which series. The DOM has purely visual swatches. We should add `role=img` + `aria-label` on the chart and explicit accessible names on legend items, e.g., `<li role="listitem" aria-label="Errors (red)">`.

priya: Small keyboard trap: the inline action menu uses a focusable <a> for the menu opener and a visually-hidden <a> we added for analytics linking. That hidden anchor is getting focus. We should make it tabindex="-1" and move analytics to pointer-only.

a11y-bot: Automated note: Axe-core flagged 3 violations on /insights (2026-12-08): focusable hidden element, low contrast on selected-row text in light theme, and missing accessible name on legend swatch.

lucy: Proposed plan: 1) replace outline with box-shadow on .row:focus-visible and test across browsers + dark mode, 2) remove or tabindex=-1 any hidden anchors in the tab order, 3) add aria-labels/role to charts and legend items, 4) change non-critical toast to `aria-live="polite"`.

devin: I'll open a small PR for focus ring + overflow tweak. I'll add unit test + Playwright e2e that tabs through rows, opens menu, shifts back, and asserts focus is on expected row. Example Playwright snippet I plan to add: `await page.keyboard.press('Tab'); await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown'); await expect(page.locator('.row:focus-visible')).toHaveCount(1);`

omar: I'll work on chart aria changes. Plan: wrap svg with `<figure role="img" aria-labelledby="chart-title chart-desc">`, add `<ul role="list">` for legend and each `<li aria-label="Series name, color description">`. Will test with VoiceOver and Narrator.

priya: For tokens: light-theme selected bg is #F2F7FF with blue-500 text -> contrast ~3.9:1. For normal text we need 4.5:1; options: darken text to blue-600 (#0066D6) or darken background. I'll prepare a token PR with new blue-600 for labels in selected rows.

lucy: Create a Jira ticket so we have traceability and attach screenshots + the Playwright run logs.

a11y-bot: Suggestion: add automated keyboard regression checks to CI for /insights route (smoke-level).

devin: Filed INF-4201 with repro, screenshots, and voiceover notes. Linked here.

priya: Quick accessibility nit on toasts: current toasts use `aria-live="assertive"` and are interrupting screen readers during long forms. For info toasts use `aria-live="polite"` + `aria-atomic="true"`. Critical errors can stay assertive.

omar: I'll run VoiceOver on mac + Narrator on Win and paste verbatim output in the ticket so we can tune the labels.

lucy: Thanks all. Can we have the PRs by EOD Friday? I'll review and test in dark-mode + high-contrast.

devin: On it, will tag @prod-qa for manual pass once merged.

priya: leaving one final note: when we add `box-shadow` rings, add `prefers-reduced-motion` friendly variant (no animated glows).
